styles.name: Swiss Grid
styles.avoid_for: dense editorial storytelling or romantic narratives
styles.typography: modern grotesk sans / readable neutral sans
styles.imagery: documentary photo or diagrams; no stock business icons
styles.data_visualization: neutral charts with one accent annotation
styles.motion: minimal cuts and deliberate sequential reveal
styles.failure_mode: avoid excessive decorative rules and sterile repetition
styles.slide_mix: claim / evidence / comparison / mechanism / conclusion as needed

styles.name: Editorial Journal

styles.failure_mode: do not fake a printed-magazine look with unreadable small serif text
styles.slide_mix: claim / evidence / comparison / mechanism / conclusion as needed

styles.name: Cinematic Keynote
styles.design_intent: emotional focal point and dramatic pacing
styles.typography: large sans or display / restrained body
styles.imagery: single true hero object, full bleed imagery with text-safe zone
